packages.description: Variant-aware VNAV descent table payloads and Lua hooks for Zibo 737-800X.
Variant-aware VNAV descent table payloads and Lua hooks for LevelUp 737NG.
Optional switchable FANS CDU labels and tablet selection for the LevelUp 737NG Series.
Optional takeoff and landing performance calculations on the existing Zibo and LevelUp tablet pages.
Optional persistent AUTO JETWAY ON/OFF setting for supported Zibo and LevelUp aircraft.
Optional optimized XLua runtime managed per supported Zibo or LevelUp aircraft installation.
Virtual copilot and maintenance assistant for supported Zibo and LevelUp 737NG aircraft.
Optional Windows companion for automatic IVAO UNICOM text and voice reports through YAL.
Optional Linux text-to-speech plugin, usable with YAL. Requires a separately installed Piper executable, voice model and audio output configuration; installing this plugin does not configure Piper.
Optional Hoppie ACARS connectivity plugin for supported Zibo and LevelUp aircraft.
Optional SimBrief OFP, flight-plan and weather helper with Zibo FMC uplink support.
Optional local flight-data logger for the Realbench study. Logs remain on the user's computer until shared manually.
Official LevelUp 737NG V2 paint templates, downloaded and verified independently from aircraft updates.
Optional Lufthansa livery for the LevelUp 737-700 and 737-900ER.
LevelUp weight and balance with silent runtime fallback for incompatible ACF inputs.
Optional FANS 1/A CPDLC pages and datalink fixes. Remove standalone v1.0.0 with its own installer before switching to the Toolkit. Simulator runtime testing remains pending.
Beta: FCOM landing-reference speeds for Zibo and LevelUp 737NG, including separate 900ER data. Optional; simulator validation remains open.

Beta: 27K / 26K / 24K SFP calculations for the passenger 737-800WSFP2 profile in Zibo and LevelUp. Requires the original .35 Lua baseline, with other verified MTK patches supported. Other variants and SFP-off retain existing behavior. Simulator validation and certified dispatch performance remain open.
Optional unofficial corrections to existing Zibo and LevelUp FMS behavior. Conditional corrections do not install CPDLC or Weight & Balance.
Optional ground equipment and static stairs for the five LevelUp 737NG variants. Equipment positions across all variants still need simulator feedback.

VNAV descent tables, FANS CDU and Weight & Balance are required. Calculator, AUTO JETWAY, CPDLC FANS PAGES, VREF tables (Beta), 737-800WSFP2 27K / SFP (Beta), Intentional Fixes and LevelUp GSE are optional. Sources update directly from their own releases.

Optional VNAV descent tables, Tablet Performance Calculator, AUTO JETWAY, CPDLC FANS PAGES, VREF tables (Beta), 737-800WSFP2 27K / SFP (Beta) and Intentional Fixes. No patch is required or selected automatically.
